This extreme weather, exacerbated by human-driven climate change, is expected to bring multiple crises, including heat, heavy rain, and food shortages, to...
summary.zh: 亚洲各国政府正紧急为有记录以来最严重的厄尔尼诺现象做准备，预计将出现大范围的干旱、野火、台风和洪水。这种由人为气候变化加剧的极端天气，预计将从现在到2027年给数亿人带来包括高温、暴雨和粮食短缺在内的多重危机。

body.en: From Sri Lanka to South Korea, governments are preparing for droughts, wildfires, typhoons and floods – with climate plans facing their biggest challenge to date Asian governments are rushing preparations for the most severe El Niño weather event on record, with hundreds of millions of people bracing for multiple crises at once as extreme heat, heavy rain and food shortages hit the region. Fuelled by exceptionally warm ocean conditions across the tropical Pacific – and developing alongside the human-driven climate crisis – El Niño is virtually guaranteed to grow to a very strong intensity towards the end of this year and into 2027. Continue reading...
body.zh: 从斯里兰卡到韩国，各国政府正在为干旱、野火、台风和洪水做准备——气候计划面临迄今为止最大的挑战。亚洲各国政府正在加紧准备，应对有记录以来最严重的厄尔尼诺天气事件，随着极端高温、暴雨和粮食短缺袭击该地区，数亿人同时面临多重危机。在热带太平洋异常温暖的海洋条件的推动下，并与人类造成的气候危机一起发展，厄尔尼诺现象几乎肯定会在今年年底和 2027 年增长到非常强烈的强度。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Asia braces for the impacts of a 'supersized' El Niño, the scale of potential devastation—droughts, wildfires, floods—underscores humanity's vulnerability to natural forces. In such times, the ancient words of Psalm 46:1 offer a profound reminder: 'God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.' This truth offers solace and a call to...
reflection.zh: 随着亚洲为“巨型”厄尔尼诺现象的影响做准备，潜在破坏的规模——干旱、野火、洪水——凸显了人类在自然力量面前的脆弱性。在这样的时刻，诗篇46:1古老的言语提供了一个深刻的提醒：“雅伟是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是患难中随时的帮助。”这个真理在风暴聚集之时，为人们提供了慰藉，并呼唤人们寻求坚定不移的希望。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Hong Kong to face 130k manpower shortage in 2028 – 50k less than previously projected
title.zh: 香港2028年预计面临13万劳动力短缺——比此前预测少5万

summary.en: New government figures indicate Hong Kong will likely face a manpower shortage of approximately 130,000 by 2028, a reduction from the previous projection of 180,000. This update was released by the Labour and Welfare Bureau following the launch of a talent attraction office.
summary.zh: 新的政府数据显示，香港到2028年预计将面临约13万的劳动力短缺，这比此前预测的18万有所下降。劳工及福利局在推出一个吸引人才的办公室后公布了这一最新预测。

body.en: Hong Kong is expected to face a manpower shortage of around 130,000 by 2028, new government figures have revealed – a significant drop from the last official projection. The opening ceremony of Hong Kong Talent Engage, an office specially for talent attraction and services launched on October 20, 2023. Photo: Kyle Lam/ HKFP. The latest mid-term manpower projection from the Labour and Welfare Bureau came during a press conference on Thursday, one day after leader John Lee unveiled the city’s first Five-Year Plan and his fifth Policy Address. It represents a reduction from the last numbers released in 2023, which estimated that Hong Kong would be short of 180,000 workers in 2028. Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun attributed this reduction to government policies aimed at developing artificial intelligence (AI) and attracting top talent from outside Hong Kong. Without initiatives like the Top Talent Pass Scheme (TTPS), which relaxes visa requirements for top earners and graduates from elite universities, Hong Kong would be around 300,000 workers short in 2028, Sun said. Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The labour chief also said on Thursday that TTPS visa holders will see further relaxations to visa extension requirements. For example, employees of start-ups based in Cyberport, Hong Kong Science Park, or the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park will not need to submit proof of company revenue when applying for visa renewals. Government to create more jobs Chief Executive John Lee announced in his Policy Address on Wednesday that the government and the business sector will launch a two-year “30,000 Youth Employment and Internship Programme” to facilitate youth employment and development, especially for those with limited or no work experience. Sun said on Thursday that, as part of the programme, the Labour and Welfare Bureau will launch a scheme to create around 10,000 new jobs for young people in the coming two years. Only Hong Kong permanent residents aged under 29 will be eligible for the scheme, Sun said, adding that there will be no educational requirements. The University of Hong Kong. File photo: GovHK. Sun also said the Labour and Welfare Bureau will work with six major chambers of commerce, including the Employers’ Federation of Hong Kong and the Chinese General Chamber of Commerce, to encourage major companies to create new jobs. The target is to create 5,000 additional jobs in 2027 and another 5,000 in 2028. The government will cover one-third of the salaries for these positions, which must offer employment terms of at least six months.
body.zh: 新的政府数据显示，到 2028 年，香港预计将面临约 13 万名劳动力短缺，较上次官方预测大幅下降。专门从事人才吸引和服务的办公室 Hong Kong Talent Engage 于 2023 年 10 月 20 日启动。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。劳工及福利局在周四的新闻发布会上公布了最新的中期人力预测，一天前，香港领导人李家超公布了香港的第一个五年计划和第五份施政报告。这比2023年发布的最新数字有所减少，该数字预计到2028年香港将短缺18万名工人。劳工及福利局局长孙克里斯将这一减少归因于政府旨在发展人工智能（AI）和吸引香港以外顶尖人才的政策。孙说，如果没有像顶尖人才通行证计划（TTPS）这样放宽高收入者和精英大学毕业生签证要求的举措，香港到2028年将短缺约30万名工人。劳工及福利局局长孙克里斯。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。劳工部长周四还表示，TTPS 签证持有者的签证延期要求将进一步放宽。例如，位于数码港、香港科学园或港深创新及科技园的初创企业的员工在申请签证续签时无需提交公司收入证明。政府创造更多就业机会 行政长官李家超周三在施政报告中宣布，政府与商界将推出为期两年的“三万名青年就业实习计划”，以促进青年就业和发展，特别是那些工作经验有限或没有工作经验的青年。孙周四表示，作为该计划的一部分，劳工及福利局将推出一项计划，在未来两年内为年轻人创造约1万个新就业机会。孙说，只有29岁以下的香港永久性居民才有资格参加该计划，并补充说没有教育背景要求。香港大学。资料图：香港政府一站通。孙还表示，劳工及福利局将与香港雇主联合会、香港中华总商会等六大商会合作，鼓励大企业创造新就业机会。目标是到 2027 年再创造 5,000 个就业岗位，到 2028 年再创造 5,000 个就业岗位。政府将承担这些职位三分之一的工资，且雇佣期限必须至少为六个月。

reflection.en: Hong Kong's Labour and Welfare Bureau has revised its manpower shortage projections downwards, now anticipating a deficit of 130,000 workers by 2028. This adjustment comes alongside efforts to attract talent, highlighting the city's strategic planning for its future workforce. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our plans and works to Yahweh, trusting that...
reflection.zh: 香港劳工及福利局已下调了其劳动力短缺预测，目前预计到2028年将缺少13万工人。这一调整伴随着吸引人才的努力，凸显了这座城市对其未来劳动力的战略规划。箴言16:3提醒我们，要将我们的计划和工作交托给雅伟，信靠祂必使我们成就，这一原则适用于任何涉及审慎远见和执行的努力。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: 'AI City Brain' is for emergency services: govt
title.zh: “智慧城市”用于紧急服务：政府

summary.en: Hong Kong's government announced that a new integrated city management system utilizing artificial intelligence, dubbed 'AI City Brain,' will complete its initial development phase by early 2028 and mature over the next six to nine years. Officials emphasized that the system is intended for improving daily city...
summary.zh: 香港政府周四表示，一个内置人工智能的新型综合城市管理系统将于2028年第一季度完成第一阶段开发，而整个系统则需要六到九年才能成熟。官员们强调，“智慧城市大脑”将不会用于犯罪侦查或监控目的，其目的是通过“大数据分析”整合相关大数据并向政府部门提供实时信息，以改善日常城市管理和应急响应。

body.en: The government said on Thursday that a new integrated city management system with built-in artificial intelligence will complete the first phase of development by the first quarter of 2028, while the full system will take six to nine years to mature. Officials stressed "AI City Brain" will not be used for crime-detection or surveillance purposes, saying the aim is to improve day-to-day city management and emergency response. Under the plan announced in Wednesday's Policy Address, "AI City Brain" would "link up and consolidate relevant big data" and feed real-time information to government departments through "big data analytics". Chief Secretary Eric Chan, who will lead a task force to take forward the initiative, said HK$200 million has been earmarked for the first phase of the system's buildout. "Total budget is not yet... we do not have any estimation now, because you know that after six to nine years, I really don't know how fast or how cheap the IT is, maybe the prices could go down quickly," he said. He added that by the third quarter of 2028, the system is expected to connect to the 1823 Contact Centre and the databases of emergency services. "I want to reiterate that the "[AI] City Brain" system is not for crime detection. It is for city management. This is a very important principle," he said. "These computer systems, they're now operating separately, independently, I would say, in different departments. But I think we want to, we want them to integrate into a single system, and adding the function of AI, then we can predict any disasters or any accidents from happening. This is a very, very important purpose." At the same press conference, Secretary for Security Chris Tang said the new Huanggang port is expected to start operating by the fourth quarter of this year. He said more than 100 system trials, stress tests and drills have been conducted so far, helping officials to rectify issues such as Wi-Fi connectivity and slippery driveways at the public transport interchange. Edited by Raymond Yeung
body.zh: 政府周四表示，内置人工智能的新型综合城市管理系统将于 2028 年第一季度完成第一阶段开发，而整个系统需要六到九年的时间才能成熟。官员们强调，“人工智能城市大脑”不会用于犯罪侦查或监视目的，称其目的是改善日常城市管理和应急响应。根据周三施政报告公布的计划，“人工智能城市大脑”将“连接和整合相关大数据”，并通过“大数据分析”向政府部门提供实时信息。政务司司长陈家祥将率领一个专责小组推进这项计划，他表示已预留 2 亿港元用于该系统第一阶段的建设。 “总预算还没有……我们现在没有任何估计，因为你知道，六到九年后，我真的不知道IT的速度有多快或有多便宜，也许价格会很快下降，”他说。他补充说，到2028年第三季度，该系统预计将连接到1823联络中心和紧急服务数据库。 “我想重申，‘人工智能城市大脑’系统不是为了犯罪侦查，而是为了城市管理。这是一个非常重要的原则，”他说。 “这些计算机系统，我想说，它们现在在不同的部门单独、独立地运行。但我认为我们希望，我们希望它们集成到一个系统中，并添加人工智能的功能，然后我们可以预测任何灾难或任何事故的发生。这是一个非常非常重要的目的。”在同一场新闻发布会上，保安局局长唐英年表示，新皇岗口岸预计将于今年第四季度投入运营。他说，到目前为止，已经进行了100多次系统试验、压力测试和演习，帮助官员纠正公共交通交汇处的Wi-Fi连接和车道湿滑等问题。杨雷蒙编辑

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of technology, as seen in Hong Kong's 'AI City Brain' project, reflects a world where knowledge and data processing are accelerating. Daniel 12:4 speaks of knowledge increasing in the "time of the end," a prophecy that resonates with our current era of unprecedented technological growth. As we develop powerful tools like AI, may we...
reflection.zh: 香港“智慧城市大脑”项目所展现的技术飞速发展，反映了一个知识和数据处理日益加速的世界。但以理书12:4预言“末期”知识将增长，这与我们当前前所未有的技术增长时代产生了共鸣。当我们开发人工智能等强大工具时，愿我们寻求智慧，将其用于共同利益，确保它们服务于人类而非控制人类。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Evening News on TV32 - Sep 17
title.zh: 行政长官周四就最新政策蓝图回答议员及公众提问

summary.en: The Chief Executive will address questions from lawmakers and the public regarding his latest policy blueprints on Thursday.
summary.zh: 行政长官将于周四就其最新政策蓝图回答议员及公众的提问。

reflection.en: As leaders present their visions and plans, the call to 'act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with your God' echoes through the halls of governance. May those in power seek wisdom not just for effective policy, but for policies that reflect divine justice and compassion for all citizens.
reflection.zh: 当领导者提出他们的愿景和计划时，‘行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心与你的雅伟同行’的呼召在治理的殿堂中回响。愿掌权者不仅寻求有效的政策，更寻求能反映雅伟的公义和对所有公民的怜悯的政策。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Innovation spending boost by 2030 'aggressive target'
title.zh: 2030年创新支出翻倍目标‘雄心勃勃’

summary.en: Hong Kong's Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry, Sun Dong, has stated that the government aims to nearly double its spending on innovation within the next five years. This initiative, part of the city's first five-year blueprint, seeks to increase domestic innovation expenditure from 1.63% of GDP in 2024...
summary.zh: 创新、科技及工业局局长孙东表示，政府的目标是在未来五年内将创新方面的支出几乎翻倍。这是香港首份五年规划的一部分，旨在将本地创新活动支出从2024年的占本地生产总值的1.63%提高到2030年的3%。孙形容这是一个‘雄心勃勃的目标’，旨在推动政府和行业的投资。

body.en: Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong said he hopes the government's goal of almost doubling spending on innovation in the coming five years will attract more funds to the city. According to Hong Kong's inaugural five-year blueprint, the SAR will strive to raise domestic expenditure on innovation activities to 3 percent of GDP by 2030 from 1.63 percent in 2024. "This is a relatively aggressive target," Sun told reporters. "We want to use this indicator to measure as well as to push for more investments on these innovation activities – not only from government side, but also mainly from the industry. "In Hong Kong, as we are pressing ahead with the new industrialisation development, we hope in the coming five years more investment from industry will go to the innovation activities, including now we also encourage many enterprises to establish R&D centres and so on." Sun said the target would cover not only expenditure on basic applied research commonly seen in universities, but also activities by enterprises such as product design, software development and pilot production. The government also expects a 10 percent increase in average annual expenditure in the next five years. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 创新科技及工业局局长孙东表示，他希望政府在未来五年将创新支出增加近一倍的目标将吸引更多资金流入香港。根据香港首个五年蓝图，香港特区将力争到2030年将国内创新活动支出占GDP的比例从2024年的1.63%提高到3%。“这是一个相对激进的目标，”孙告诉记者。 “我们希望通过这个指标来衡量，并推动对这些创新活动的更多投资——不仅是政府方面，而且主要是来自工业界。在香港，随着我们正在推进新型工业化发展，我们希望未来五年工业界能有更多的投资投向创新活动，包括现在我们也鼓励很多企业建立研发中心等等。”孙说，这个目标不仅包括大学里常见的基础应用研究的支出，还包括企业的活动，例如产品设计、软件等。政府还预计未来五年的年均支出将增加 10%（Edmond Fong 编辑）。

reflection.en: Hong Kong is setting an ambitious target to significantly increase its investment in innovation and technology. This drive for progress and development reflects a human desire to build and create, seeking a better future. As plans are made and resources are allocated, may the efforts be guided by wisdom and a commitment to excellence, trusting that the...
reflection.zh: 香港设定了一个雄心勃勃的目标，旨在大幅增加对创新和技术的投资。这种对进步和发展的追求反映了人类建设和创造、寻求更美好未来的愿望。在制定计划和分配资源时，愿这些努力都能得到智慧的指引和卓越的承诺，并信靠最终的成果都在雅伟的手中。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: ‘No doubt’ of climate change role in deadly China-Nepal flood: scientists
title.zh: 科学家：气候变化是导致中尼边境洪灾的“核心因素”

summary.en: Scientists have identified climate change as a primary factor in a recent glacial mountain collapse on the China-Nepal border, which resulted in over 1,400 deaths and left 6,600 missing. The disaster was characterized as a 'compound crisis' involving long-term warming, glacier retreat, permafrost thaw, and geological...
summary.zh: 科学家们指出，气候变化是近期中尼边境冰川山体崩塌的主要因素，此次灾难已导致超过1400人死亡，另有6600人失踪。该事件被描述为一场“复合危机”，涉及长期变暖、冰川退缩、永久冻土融化和地质不稳定，而非单一的极端天气事件。

body.en: Climate change was a core factor in last month’s deadly glacial mountain collapse on the China-Nepal border that killed more than 1,400 people and left at least 6,600 missing, scientists said Thursday. A man looks at the remains in the aftermath of flash floods at Trishuli in Nepal’s Nuwakot district on September 7, 2026. Photo: Pedro Pardo/AFP. However, scientists from the World Weather Attribution (WWA) group said, the disaster was not caused by a single extreme weather event, rather a “compound crisis” shaped by long-term warming, glacier retreat, permafrost thaw and geological instability. “Relentless warming has lifted the altitude of the freezing threshold on the high Himalaya, exposing ice and permafrost deep in the bedrock to higher and longer thaw temperatures, weakening mountain slopes,” a WWA report said. A massive section of rock and glacier broke away from Langtang Lirung mountain on August 26, triggering a huge flood of water, ice and debris that swept downstream, destroying communities and infrastructure. ‘Irreversible shifts’ Report co-author Walter Immerzeel, a mountain hydrologist at Utrecht University, said the region was undergoing “fundamental, irreversible shifts”, with glacier retreat and permafrost degradation undermining mountain stability. “We conclude that this was a geologically vulnerable slope, potentially weakened by the 2015 earthquake, but it was destabilised further by glacier retreat and permafrost fall,” Immerzeel told reporters. Nepal, a largely rural nation of 30 million people, contributes a fraction of global greenhouse gas emissions compared to industrialised nations. The study found that July and August 2026 were the warmest months locally recorded, while heavy snowfall in late 2025 contributed to increased meltwater before the collapse. A magnitude 7.8 earthquake in Nepal in 2015 may have further weakened the slope, although its precise role remains uncertain, the report said. Workers repair a section of road leading to Gyirong Port on August 28, 2026, which was damaged after a mudslide two days earlier, in Gyirong County. Photo: CNS/AFP. Last month’s disaster has also raised concerns about the limits of adaptation. Prime Minister Balendra Shah will take his first foreign trip as Nepal’s leader to address the UN General Assembly on the urgent issue next week. Nepal estimates the reconstruction bill after deadly floods sparked by a glacial mountain collapse last month will amount to $4.78 billion. ‘No doubt’ “There is no doubt that climate change is one of the drivers, and therefore obviously it needs to be discussed in the context of loss and damage,” Friederike Otto, a professor of climate science at...
body.zh: 科学家周四表示，气候变化是上个月中尼边境致命冰川山崩塌的核心因素，这场崩塌造成 1,400 多人死亡，至少 6,600 人失踪。 2026 年 9 月 7 日，尼泊尔努瓦科特地区特里苏里，一名男子正在查看山洪暴发后的遗骸。照片：Pedro Pardo/法新社。然而，世界天气归因组织（WWA）的科学家表示，这场灾难并不是单一的极端天气事件造成的，而是由长期变暖、冰川退缩、永久冻土融化和地质不稳定所形成的“复合危机”。世界气象组织的一份报告称：“持续的变暖提高了喜马拉雅山高处的冰冻阈值，使基岩深处的冰和永久冻土暴露在更高和更长时间的解冻温度下，削弱了山坡。” 8 月 26 日，一大片岩石和冰川从 Langtang Lirung 山脱落，引发洪水、冰和碎片席卷下游，摧毁了社区和基础设施。 “不可逆转的变化”报告的合著者、乌得勒支大学山区水文学家沃尔特·伊默泽尔表示，该地区正在经历“根本性的、不可逆转的变化”，冰川退缩和永久冻土退化破坏了山区的稳定性。伊默泽尔告诉记者：“我们的结论是，这是一个地质脆弱的斜坡，可能会因 2015 年地震而变得脆弱，但冰川退缩和永久冻土层塌陷进一步破坏了它的稳定性。”尼泊尔是一个拥有 3000 万人口、以农村为主的国家，与工业化国家相比，其温室气体排放量仅占全球温室气体排放量的一小部分。研究发现，2026年7月和8月是当地有记录以来最温暖的月份，而2025年末的大雪导致崩塌前融水增加。报告称，2015 年尼泊尔发生的 7.8 级地震可能进一步削弱了斜坡，但其确切作用仍不确定。 2026 年 8 月 28 日，工人们正在修复吉隆县通往吉隆口岸的一段道路，该道路因两天前的泥石流而受损。照片：CNS/法新社。上个月的灾难也引发了人们对适应局限性的担忧。巴伦德拉·沙阿总理将于下周作为尼泊尔领导人首次出访，在联合国大会上就这一紧迫问题发表讲话。尼泊尔估计上个月冰川山崩塌引发致命洪水后的重建费用将达到 47.8 亿美元。 “毫无疑问”“毫无疑问，气候变化是驱动因素之一，因此显然需要在损失和损害的背景下进行讨论，”弗里德里克·奥托（Friederike Otto），气候科学教授。

reflection.en: The earth itself groans, bearing the weight of human impact and systemic disruption. As scientists link this devastating flood to climate change, we see a world out of balance, a consequence of long-term warming and environmental instability. May we recognize our interconnectedness with creation and seek wisdom to live as faithful stewards.
reflection.zh: 大地本身也在呻吟，承受着人类活动和系统性破坏的重负。当科学家们将这场毁灭性的洪水与气候变化联系起来时，我们看到了一个失衡的世界，这是长期变暖和环境不稳定的后果。愿我们认识到与受造界的相互联系，并寻求智慧，作为忠实的管家生活。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Man jailed 4 weeks for grabbing passerby by the neck and attempting to kiss her
title.zh: 男子因非礼罪被判监禁四周

summary.en: A 29-year-old man in Hong Kong has been sentenced to four weeks in prison for indecent assault after pleading guilty to grabbing a female passerby by the neck and attempting to kiss her. The incident occurred in the early hours of Tuesday in Shau Kei Wan.
summary.zh: 一名29岁的香港男子因非礼罪被判处四周监禁。他承认在周二凌晨于筲箕湾袭击一名路过的女子，抓住她的脖子并试图亲吻她。

body.en: A Hong Kong man accused of grabbing the neck of a female passerby and attempting to kiss her has been sentenced to four weeks in prison for indecent assault. Eastern Law Courts Building. Photo: Almond Li/HKFP. Fung Ho-yin, 29, appeared at the Eastern Magistrates’ Courts on Wednesday, The Witness reported . He pleaded guilty to a charge of indecent assault stemming from an incident in the early hours of Tuesday in Shau Kei Wan. Fung was sitting on a bench in a park on Nam On Street at around 1am that day when a woman – known to the court as X – walked past him, according to the prosecution. Fung first attempted to take a photo of X. He then stood up and followed her, and wrapped his left arm around X’s neck while using his other arm to touch her chest. He also tried to kiss her, the prosecution said. X managed to escape and screamed for help. Nam On Street Sitting-out Area in Shau Kei Wan. Photo: Wikicommons. She got the attention of a man inside a nearby gym, who ran out and helped her. X then called the police. Officers arrived at the scene and arrested Fung, who admitted under police caution that he had committed the offence out of impulse, The Witness reported. He told police he was attracted to X’s miniskirt and hoped to get close to and speak with her. But X noticed him approach and told him to go away, he said. See also: Hong Kong court acquits gov’t statistician who followed, photographed girl during school open day Handing down the sentence, Magistrate Kestrel Lam said the incident occurred in the quiet of the night, and that the consequences would have been hard to predict if nobody had come forward. He said that even though Fung had no criminal record, this was a serious case that warranted imprisonment, Ming Pao reported . Indecent assault is punishable by up to 10 years’ imprisonment, although jail terms in magistrates’ courts are capped at two years for a single offence.
body.zh: 一名香港男子被控抓住一名女性路人的脖子并试图亲吻她，因猥亵罪被判处四个星期监禁。东区法院大楼。照片：Almond Li/HKFP。据《见证人》报道，29 岁的冯浩然周三在东区裁判法院出庭。他承认因周二凌晨在筲箕湾发生的一起事件而被控猥亵罪。检方称，当天凌晨 1 点左右，冯正坐在南安街一个公园的长凳上，一名女子（法庭称 X）从他身边走过。冯先尝试给X拍照，然后起身跟随X，左臂搂住X的脖子，另一只手抚摸X的胸部。检方称，他还试图亲吻她。 X成功逃脱并大声呼救。筲箕湾南安街休憩处。照片：维基共享资源。她引起了附近健身房内一名男子的注意，后者跑出去帮助了她。 X随后报了警。据《见证人》报道，警察赶到现场并逮捕了冯，冯在警方的警告下承认自己是出于冲动而犯罪。他告诉警方，他被X的迷你裙所吸引，希望能接近她并与她交谈。但 X 注意到他走近并告诉他走开，他说。另请参阅：香港法院宣判一名政府统计员无罪，该统计员在学校开放日期间跟踪并拍摄了一名女孩。 裁判官林凯斯特在宣判时表示，这起事件发生在深夜，如果没有人挺身而出，后果将难以预测。据《明报》报道，他表示，尽管冯没有犯罪记录，但案情严重，应入狱。猥亵罪最高可判处 10 年监禁，但治安法院对单次犯罪的刑期上限为两年。

reflection.en: This incident highlights the vulnerability of individuals in public spaces and the violation of personal boundaries. The legal system has responded with a sentence, but the deeper wound of assault and the fear it instills remain. We are called to defend the oppressed and seek justice, ensuring that such violations are not overlooked and that victims find...
reflection.zh: 这起事件凸显了公众场所个体所面临的脆弱性以及个人界限被侵犯的严重性。法律系统已作出判决，但袭击造成的创伤和由此产生的恐惧依然存在。我们蒙召要为受欺压者辩护，寻求公义，确保此类侵犯行为不被忽视，并让受害者找到支持和安全。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: China imposes travel curbs to protect ‘national security’ amid superpower tech race
title.zh: 中国为保护“国家安全”实施旅行限制，以应对超级大国科技竞赛

summary.en: China imposed sweeping travel restrictions on its citizens on Tuesday, including exit bans on those deemed to endanger the country’s “industrial or technological security”. Citizens who violate technology import and export regulations could be banned from leaving China, the State Council said.
summary.zh: 中国周二对公民实施了广泛的旅行限制，包括禁止那些被认为危及国家“工业或技术安全”的人员出境。国务院表示，违反技术进出口规定的公民可能会被禁止离开中国。

body.en: China imposed sweeping travel restrictions on its citizens on Tuesday, including exit bans on those deemed to endanger the country’s “industrial or technological security”. File photo: Lukas Messmer/HKFP. Citizens who violate technology import and export regulations could be banned from leaving China, the State Council said. Those who engage in illegal activities abroad could be “prohibited from leaving the country for a period of six months to three years from the date of their return to China”. China and the United States have been locked in a tech race, with both sides accusing the other in recent months of stealing the capabilities of locally developed artificial intelligence models. The new rules, first released in July but in effect from Tuesday, were formulated to “safeguard national sovereignty, security, and development interests”, the State Council said. ‘Wide remit’ However, analysts warn that the travel rules give China a “wide remit”. A robot is displayed at the Hong Kong Productivity Council’s AI exhibition in Kowloon Tong on May 21, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Security and criminal activities “can be vaguely defined and easily adjusted”, Chong Ja Ian from the National University of Singapore told AFP. “The outside world will only know how it applies that remit after there are cases of implementation,” he said. Chong pointed to reports of exit bans on foreign nationals, including the recent case of US citizen Min Zin. The US government has said the political analyst was taken into Chinese custody in Yunnan province on June 3 and was held improperly. China refuted the accusations in August, saying Min Zin was suspected of violating Chinese law. “The case of Min Zin is a reminder that the range of people (that China) could restrict from exiting could be quite wide — and potentially arbitrary,” Chong said. Dylan Loh, an associate professor at Singapore’s Nanyang Technological University, told AFP the travel restrictions “send a message” that China will take action to prevent “leaks in security or national interest-sensitive areas”.
body.zh: 中国周二对其公民实施了全面的旅行限制，包括对那些被认为危及该国“工业或技术安全”的人实施出境禁令。资料照片：Lukas Messmer/HKFP。国务院表示，违反技术进出口规定的公民可能会被禁止出境。那些在境外从事非法活动的人可能“自返回中国之日起六个月至三年内禁止出境”。中国和美国陷入了一场科技竞赛，近几个月来双方都指责对方窃取了当地开发的人工智能模型的能力。国务院表示，新规定于 7 月首次发布，自周二起生效，旨在“维护国家主权、安全、发展利益”。 “广泛的职权范围” 然而，分析人士警告说，旅行规则赋予中国“广泛的职权范围”。 2026 年 5 月 21 日，香港生产力促进局在九龙塘举办的人工智能展览上展示了一台机器人。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。新加坡国立大学的庄嘉伊恩 (Chong Ja Ian) 告诉法新社，安全和犯罪活动“可以被模糊地定义，并且很容易调整”。他说：“只有在有实施案例后，外界才会知道它如何适用。” Chong提到了有关外国人出境禁令的报道，包括最近发生的美国公民敏津的案件。美国政府表示，这名政治分析家于6月3日在云南省被中国拘留，且拘留方式不当。中国八月份驳斥了这些指控，称敏津涉嫌违反中国法律。 “敏津的案例提醒人们，（中国）可以限制退出的人群范围可能相当广泛，而且可能是任意的，”庄说。新加坡南洋理工大学副教授迪伦·卢告诉法新社，旅行限制“发出了一个信息”，即中国将采取行动防止“安全或国家利益敏感领域的泄密”。

reflection.en: The news of China restricting travel to protect 'industrial or technological security' echoes the ancient story of Babel. There, human ambition, coupled with technological prowess, sought to reach the heavens, leading to divine confusion. This modern restriction, born from a global tech race, raises questions about where human ingenuity finds its limits and...
reflection.zh: 中国为保护“工业或技术安全”而实施旅行限制的消息，令人联想到古代巴别塔的故事。在那里，人类的野心加上技术实力，试图触及天堂，最终导致了神的混乱。这项源于全球科技竞赛的现代限制，引发了关于人类创造力极限和最终目的的思考。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sentencing of Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan highlights a profound tension between civic duty and conscience. Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Wall Street Journal publisher convicted in Hong Kong of deterring reporter from union role
title.zh: 《华尔街日报》出版商在香港被判犯有阻止记者担任工会职务的罪名

summary.en: Dow Jones, the publisher of The Wall Street Journal, has been convicted in a Hong Kong court of one count of deterring reporter Selina Cheng from taking up a role at the Hong Kong Journalist Association. The case raised concerns about press freedom in the city, as Cheng was dismissed weeks after her appointment as...
summary.zh: 《华尔街日报》的出版商道琼斯公司在香港一家法院被判犯有一项阻止记者郑丽莎担任香港记者协会职务的罪名。此案引发了对该市新闻自由的担忧，郑女士在2024年被任命为香港记协主席数周后被公司以重组为由解雇。

body.en: Dow Jones convicted of one count of deterring Selina Cheng from role at Hong Kong Journalist Association but cleared of second charge A Hong Kong court has convicted the publisher of the Wall Street Journal of deterring a reporter from taking up a trade union role, in a case that raised concerns about press freedom in the city. The newspaper dismissed Selina Cheng just weeks after she was appointed chair of the Hong Kong Journalist Association (HKJA) in 2024. She was told at the time her termination was officially due to restructuring. Continue reading...
body.zh: 道琼斯因一项阻止郑秀玲在香港记者协会任职的罪名被定罪，但第二项指控被洗清。香港一家法院判定《华尔街日报》出版商阻止一名记者担任工会职务的罪名成立，此案引起了人们对香港新闻自由的担忧。该报在 2024 年被任命为香港记者协会 (HKJA) 主席几周后解雇了郑嘉颖。当时她被告知，她的解雇正式是由于重组。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Dow Jones in Hong Kong for deterring a reporter from union activity underscores a troubling trend where corporate actions can stifle worker advocacy. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly and loving mercy, even in the face of corporate restructuring or perceived inconvenience. May we pray for leaders...
reflection.zh: 道琼斯公司在香港被判阻止记者参与工会活动，这凸显了一个令人担忧的趋势：企业行为可能扼杀工人维权。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于秉行公义，喜爱怜悯，即使面对企业重组或所谓的“不便”。愿我们为媒体和商业界的领导者祈祷，愿他们坚守这些原则，确保追求利润不会掩盖员工的基本权利和尊严。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 不明谋杀评论——香港外星人绑架和真实犯罪影响者的戏谑模仿

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes the limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers,...
summary.zh: 在一部低成本的喜剧冒险片《不明谋杀》中，童年好友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪，该片突破了讲故事的界限。由郭嘉熙和李振杰执导的这部规模不大但结构精巧的喜剧，以一种随心所欲的戏谑方式模仿了真实犯罪爱好者和伪网红，其风格充满爱意而非恶意。影片围绕一个（虚构的）25年前的案件展开，该案件吸引了整个香港的关注。

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……真的是这样吗？影片以一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一种竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一种写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film playfully satirizes how a single, unverified story can capture the imagination of an entire city for decades. It reminds us of the importance of discernment, especially in the age of influencers and viral narratives, urging us to seek out all sides before forming a conclusion. Proverbs 18:17 speaks to this, noting that the first to speak in a...
reflection.zh: 这部电影以一种戏谑的方式讽刺了一个未经证实的故事如何能长达数十年地吸引整座城市的想象力。它提醒我们在充斥着网红和病毒式传播叙事的时代，辨别真伪尤为重要，并敦促我们在下结论前倾听各方声音。箴言18:17对此深有体会，指出在争论中先开口的人似乎有理，但真相只有在双方都被倾听后才能显现。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: In hottest summer on record, 2 in 3 Americans say climate change is increasing heat-related illnesses
title.zh: 在创纪录的夏季，三分之二的美国人认为气候变化正在增加与热相关的疾病

summary.en: According to a new survey, nearly two-thirds of Americans believe climate change is exacerbating health issues like respiratory diseases and heat- and insect-related illnesses. This comes as the past summer was recorded as the warmest in the contiguous U.S. since record-keeping began 132 years ago.
summary.zh: 根据一项新调查，近三分之二的美国人认为气候变化正在加剧呼吸道疾病以及与高温和昆虫相关的疾病等健康问题。此前，美国国家海洋和大气管理局宣布，过去一个夏季（6月至8月）是有记录以来美国本土最热的夏季，已有132年历史。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Nearly two-thirds of the American public say climate change is increasing the risk of respiratory diseases and heat- and insect-related illnesses, according to a new survey from the Annenberg Public Policy Center (APPC) of the University of Pennsylvania.

In September 2026, the U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) announced that the past summer, from June through August, had been the warmest in the lower contiguous 48 states in the 132 years records have been kept. The United Nations reported that global sea surface temperatures had "reached an all-time observed high."

The policy center's nationally representative Annenberg Science and Public Health (ASAPH) survey, conducted Aug. 4–17, 2026, among 1,904 empaneled U.S. adults, finds that 76% report that extreme outdoor heat affected their daily activities at least sometimes in the past year and 38% say poor air quality resulting from wildfire smoke did so. The American Lung Association's "State of the Air" 2026 report found that 44% of Americans are living in areas that earn "failing grades for unhealthy levels of ozone or particle pollution."

Extreme heat is affecting the everyday lives of most Americans, the survey finds.

"Extreme heat is no longer just an occasional inconvenience," said Ken Winneg, APPC's managing director of survey research. "It is affecting Americans' household budgets and daily routines, from electricity bills to simply going outside."

Nearly two-thirds of Americans (65%) say that climate change is increasing the risk of heat-related illnesses, respiratory diseases and insect-borne diseases. This is unchanged from August 2025 (65%) and July 2024 (67%) but is significantly higher than 58% in November 2023.

Americans generally recognize that heat waves are on the rise. Nearly two-thirds (62%) say U.S. heat waves are becoming more frequent and intense than in the past, statistically unchanged from 61% in August 2025, 65% in July 2024 and 58% in November 2023.

Of the four extreme weather events measured in the survey, more Americans report that their daily activities were affected at least sometimes by extreme outdoor heat (76%) and poor air quality resulting from wildfire smoke (38%). As one would expect, fewer say they were affected at least sometimes by flooding (20%) and tornadoes or hurricanes (11%), since these events are less frequent.

Experiencing extreme outdoor heat, poor air quality and flooding that affected daily activities in the past year increased the likelihood that respondents believed climate change is increasing the risk of heat-related illnesses,...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 宾夕法尼亚大学安纳伯格公共政策中心 (APPC) 的一项新调查显示，近三分之二的美国公众表示，气候变化正在增加患呼吸道疾病以及与高温和昆虫相关疾病的风险。 2026 年 9 月，美国国家海洋和大气管理局 (NOAA) 宣布，去年 6 月至 8 月的夏季是 132 年来有记录以来，邻近 48 个州的最温暖夏季。联合国报告称，全球海洋表面温度已“达到历史最高水平”。 该政策中心于 2026 年 8 月 4 日至 17 日对 1,904 名美国成年人进行了具有全国代表性的安纳伯格科学与公共卫生 (ASAPH) 调查，结果发现，76% 的人表示，在过去一年中，极端的室外高温至少有时影响了他们的日常活动，38% 的人表示，野火烟雾导致的空气质量不佳也影响了他们的日常活动。美国肺脏协会的《2026 年空气状况》报告发现，44% 的美国人生活在“臭氧或颗粒污染不健康水平不及格”的地区。 调查发现，极端高温正在影响大多数美国人的日常生活。 APPC 调查研究常务董事肯·温尼格 (Ken Winneg) 表示：“酷热不再只是偶尔造成的不便。” “它正在影响美国人的家庭预算和日常生活，从电费到外出。” 近三分之二的美国人 (65%) 表示，气候变化正在增加患与热有关的疾病、呼吸道疾病和虫媒疾病的风险。这与 2025 年 8 月 (65%) 和 2024 年 7 月 (67%) 持平，但明显高于 2023 年 11 月的 58%。 美国人普遍认识到热浪正在加剧。近三分之二 (62%) 的人表示，美国的热浪比过去变得更加频繁和强烈，与 2025 年 8 月的 61%、2024 年 7 月的 65% 和 2023 年 11 月的 58% 相比，统计数据没有变化。 在调查中测量的四种极端天气事件中，更多的美国人表示，他们的日常活动至少有时会受到室外极端高温（76%）和野火烟雾造成的恶劣空气质量（38%）的影响。正如人们所预料的那样，很少有人说他们至少有时会受到洪水（20%）和龙卷风或飓风（11%）的影响，因为这些事件发生的频率较低。 过去一年中经历了极端的室外高温、空气质量差和洪水影响了日常活动，这增加了受访者认为气候变化正在增加与高温相关疾病的风险的可能性，...

reflection.en: As the planet experiences its hottest summer on record, a significant majority of Americans recognize the link between climate change and increasing heat-related illnesses. This widespread concern echoes the ancient truth that the Earth is Yahweh's, and with its fullness, the world and those who dwell in it. Our stewardship of this creation is a profound...
reflection.zh: 随着地球经历创纪录的最热夏季，绝大多数美国人认识到气候变化与日益增长的热相关疾病之间的联系。这种普遍的担忧呼应了一个古老的真理：地和其中所充满的，世界和居住在其间的，都属雅伟。我们对这受造之物的管理，是一项深远的责任，呼吁我们关爱那供养我们所有人的环境。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: When prepping for disaster, don't forget to pack your teddy bear
title.zh: 灾难准备时，别忘了打包你的泰迪熊

summary.en: A survey of UK adults found that a significant number of people, when asked what they would pack in an emergency go-bag, prioritized sentimental items such as a childhood teddy bear. This highlights the emotional and psychological needs people have when facing potential disaster, alongside practical supplies.
summary.zh: 一项针对英国成年人的调查发现，当被问及在应急包中会打包什么物品时，相当多的人优先考虑了诸如童年泰迪熊之类的纪念品。这凸显了人们在面对潜在灾难时，除了实际的物资需求外，还存在情感和心理上的需求。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Imagine it's the dead of night. Your phone pings with a text—it's a government emergency alert: "Leave your home immediately! Only take with you enough supplies for the next three days." What would you want in your go-bag?

Our new survey of UK adults (results not yet published) found a surprising number of people prioritized sentimental belongings such as a childhood teddy bear.

In the face of climate change and growing geopolitical instability, governments have started advising citizens to prepare now for disaster. In 2024, the UK government launched its Prepare initiative. This was followed by preparEU, a flagship EU project that argued: "Today's threats are fast, complex and interconnected; our response must be more proactive."

These initiatives typically recommend that people have enough food, water and medicine to last 72 hours. In addition, they need ready access to documents, cash, batteries or power banks and a wind-up radio, plus a working knowledge of emergency support in their local area.

But when that message pings in the night, will you already be packed, with documents, food and medicine in a go-bag? Or will you be scrambling to find things, hoping you have enough essentials to keep you going?

In April 2026, as part of the After the End project—a research project exploring how people experience and recover from crises—we surveyed 1,000 UK adults to understand how prepared they were for a sudden crisis or disaster.

We found that most people have less than half of what is recommended by the UK government and the U.S. Federal Emergency Management Agency . Only 4 out of 1,000 people reported being fully prepared.

Our findings echo the 2025 UK Public Survey of Risk Perception, Resilience and Preparedness , which found that of 10,536 adults, only 13% felt largely or totally prepared.

However, the focus on practical items and supplies may not capture what people need to withstand the emotional toll of crises and disasters.

When asked what other items they would take with them during a crisis, many participants felt that personal items would be critical to their post-disaster well-being. They expressed a strong desire to keep sentimental items such as jewelry, family photographs and objects from their childhood close to them during a crisis.

As one participant wrote: "My childhood teddy bear. He is going to the grave with me. Apart from that, nothing matters much."

Pets also featured heavily in people's responses. Animals such as cats and dogs were often described as members of the family. Some participants even found comfort in the idea of taking the...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 想象一下这是夜深人静的时候。你的手机响起一条短信——这是政府的紧急警报：“立即离开家！只携带足够未来三天所需的物资。”您想要什么在您的旅行包里？ 我们对英国成年人的新调查（结果尚未公布）发现，有相当多的人优先考虑情感物品，例如童年的泰迪熊。 面对气候变化和日益加剧的地缘政治不稳定，各国政府已开始建议公民立即为灾难做好准备。 2024 年，英国政府启动了“准备”计划。随后推出了欧盟旗舰项目preparEU，该项目认为：“当今的威胁是快速、复杂且相互关联的；我们的应对措施必须更加积极主动。” 这些举措通常建议人们提供足够维持 72 小时的食物、水和药品。此外，他们需要随时获取文件、现金、电池或移动电源和发条收音机，以及当地紧急支持的工作知识。 但是，当这条消息在夜间响起时，您是否已经把文件、食物和药品装在旅行包里了？或者你会忙着寻找东西，希望有足够的必需品来维持你的生活吗？ 2026 年 4 月，作为“末日之后”项目（一个探索人们如何经历危机并从危机中恢复的研究项目）的一部分，我们调查了 1,000 名英国成年人，以了解他们对突发危机或灾难的准备程度。 我们发现，大多数人的防护量还不到英国政府和美国联邦紧急事务管理局建议的一半。 1000 人中只有 4 人表示做好了充分准备。 我们的研究结果与 2025 年英国风险认知、复原力和准备情况公众调查相呼应，该调查发现，在 10,536 名成年人中，只有 13% 的人感到很大程度上或完全准备好了。 然而，对实用物品和用品的关注可能无法满足人们承受危机和灾难的情感损失所需的东西。 当被问及在危机期间他们会携带哪些其他物品时，许多参与者认为个人物品对于他们灾后的福祉至关重要。他们表达了在危机期间将珠宝、家庭照片和童年时期的物品等情感物品放在身边的强烈愿望。 正如一位参与者写道：“我儿时的泰迪熊。他将和我一起走向坟墓。除此之外，没有什么重要的了。” 宠物在人们的反应中也占有重要地位。猫和狗等动物经常被描述为家庭成员。一些参与者甚至对采取……的想法感到安慰。

reflection.en: In times of crisis, the instinct to grab a cherished object, like a teddy bear, speaks to a deep human need for comfort and connection. Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, noble, lovely, and admirable, finding strength not just in practicalities but in the enduring power of love and memory.
reflection.zh: 在危机时刻，人们本能地抓起一件珍爱的物品，比如泰迪熊，这反映了人类对安慰和联结的深层需求。《腓立比书》4:8 提醒我们要将心思意念集中在凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的事上，从中汲取力量，不仅依靠实际的准备，也依靠爱与记忆的持久力量。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: See tiny organisms on show in microscopic video competition
title.zh: 显微视频竞赛展示微小生物

summary.en: The winning video of Nikon's Small World In Motion competition showcases cilia, hair-like structures in the airways of a child with a rare genetic disease, magnified 100 times. The competition celebrates microscopic film and time-lapse photography.
summary.zh: 尼康的“显微世界动态”年度竞赛的获奖视频展示了患有罕见遗传病的儿童气道中的纤毛（一种毛发状结构），放大了100倍。该竞赛旨在庆祝显微电影和延时摄影。

body.en:
Nikon's annual Small World In Motion competition is open to anyone around the world with an interest in film or time-lapse photography through a microscope.

This year's winning video was magnified to 100 times in size, and featured tiny hair-like structures, called cilia, in the airways of a child with a rare genetic disease.

It was submitted by Dr Ning Xu, a researcher at Tsinghua University in China, who used a series of complicated light waves to illuminate different parts of the sample in colour.

Runners up in the competition included videos of a roundworm encountering a single-celled organism and microscopic jellyfish larvae suspended in droplets of water. Clips of bioluminescent algae and a tiny sea slug were among the highly commended.
body.zh: 尼康一年一度的“动态小世界”竞赛向世界各地任何对显微镜胶片或延时摄影感兴趣的人开放。 今年的获奖视频尺寸被放大了 100 倍，并以患有罕见遗传病的儿童呼吸道中的微小毛发状结构（称为纤毛）为特色。 该研究由中国清华大学研究员徐宁博士提交，他使用一系列复杂的光波来照亮样本的不同部分。 比赛的亚军包括蛔虫遇到单细胞生物和悬浮在水滴中的微小水母幼虫的视频。生物发光藻类和小海蛞蝓的片段受到高度赞扬。

reflection.en: This competition reveals the intricate beauty hidden within the smallest forms of life, reminding us that even in the unseen, Yahweh's creative hand is evident. Observing these microscopic worlds can inspire awe and a deeper appreciation for the complexity of creation, a source of wisdom for those who seek it.
reflection.zh: 这项竞赛揭示了生命最小形态中隐藏的精妙之美，提醒我们即使在看不见的世界里，雅伟创造的手也显而易见。观察这些微观世界可以激发敬畏之情，并加深对创造复杂性的理解，这是寻求智慧者的智慧之源。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Robots grow and package lettuce year-round in Norway's fully automated farm
title.zh: 挪威全自动化农场：机器人全年无休种植和包装生菜

summary.en: Norway's first fully automated vegetable production facility, operational since last fall, has begun supplying stores with lettuce this spring. In this facility, no human hands touch the lettuce from sowing to packaging, ensuring a completely automated process from seed to shelf.
summary.zh: 挪威首个全自动化蔬菜生产设施自去年秋季投入运营以来，已于今年春季开始向商店供应生菜。在该设施中，从播种到包装，生菜全程无人接触，确保了从种子到货架的完全自动化流程。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Norway's first fully automated facility for vegetable production was put into operation last fall. This spring, the first products hit store shelves.

"In this facility, no one touches the lettuce from the time it is sown, grown and packaged until it ends up on the store shelf and is finally opened by the customer at home in their kitchen," says SINTEF researcher Ottar Bakås.

He and his research colleagues have studied the status of and opportunities for automated indoor vegetable production in Norway.

The facility is operated by Himmelgrønt AS, a collaborative partnership between the supermarket chain Coop Norge and the technology company Avisomo, and is located in Gardermoen, near Oslo. Its location enables the company to distribute goods quickly and efficiently to all the chain's stores around the country.

"It is still common for many tasks to be done by people, but technology has evolved to the point where we can automate manual tasks," says Aleksander Lillienskiold, a former SINTEF researcher who also participated in the project.

"We've looked at the degree of automation that exists today, what we can expect in the future and what technology we'll need going forward," says Lillienskiold.

The project has focused on "vertical farming"—a designation for indoor farming in a controlled environment where crops are grown in stacked layers.

"Growing indoors makes it possible to produce crops year-round. This means we don't need to import from abroad. And there are no pesticides or insects, so when the lettuce is ready for harvest, it can just be cut and bagged right away," says Lillienskiold.

In Avisomo's facility, robots and automation carry out all the tasks. Light, air and water are automatically adjusted to create the best possible growing conditions.

The vegetables are grown in a multilevel shelf system. One seed is placed in a unit, and the roots grow downward, where they have good access to nutrients via flowing water. The plant grows on top. Within just over two weeks, the fastest-growing lettuces are ready for harvest.

"Vertical cultivation is most often done without soil. And in a fully automated process, like at Avisomo's facility, the lettuce is also not in contact with human hands. This removes many sources of disease risk that could diminish product quality," says Bakås, a SINTEF researcher.

This growing model increases the shelf life of lettuce and herbs from 2–4 weeks to 12 weeks. In other words, the crops' lifespan is tripled.

"This is an important factor for stores. It allows them to offer customers vegetables with a much better shelf life. And...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 挪威第一座全自动蔬菜生产设施于去年秋天投入运营。今年春天，第一批产品登陆商店货架。 SINTEF 研究员 Ottar Bakås 表示：“在这个设施中，从生菜播种、种植和包装到最终上架并最终由顾客在家里的厨房打开，没有人接触过生菜。” 他和他的研究同事研究了挪威自动化室内蔬菜生产的现状和机遇。 该设施由连锁超市 Coop Norge 和科技公司 Avisomo 之间的合作伙伴 Himmelgrønt AS 运营，位于奥斯陆附近的加勒穆恩。它的地理位置使该公司能够快速有效地将货物配送到全国各地的所有连锁店。 参与该项目的前 SINTEF 研究员 Aleksander Lillienskiold 表示：“许多任务由人来完成仍然很常见，但技术已经发展到我们可以自动化手动任务的程度。” “我们研究了当今的自动化程度、我们对未来的期望以及我们未来需要哪些技术，”Lillienskiold 说。 该项目的重点是“垂直农业”——一种在受控环境中进行室内农业的名称，其中作物在堆叠层中生长。 “在室内种植可以全年生产农作物。这意味着我们不需要从国外进口。而且没有农药或昆虫，所以当生菜准备收获时，可以立即切割和装袋，”Lillienskiold 说。 在 Avisomo 的工厂中，机器人和自动化设备执行所有任务。光线、空气和水会自动调节，以创造最佳的生长条件。 蔬菜在多层货架系统中种植。将一粒种子放入一个单元中，根部向下生长，在那里它们可以通过流水很好地获取养分。植物长在上面。在短短两周内，生长最快的生菜就可以收获了。 “垂直种植通常是在没有土壤的情况下进行的。在完全自动化的过程中，比如在 Avisomo 的工厂，生菜也不与人手接触。这消除了许多可能降低产品质量的疾病风险来源，”SINTEF 研究员 Bakås 说。 这种生长模式将生菜和香草的保质期从 2-4 周延长至 12 周。换句话说，农作物的寿命延长了两倍。 “这对商店来说是一个重要因素。它使他们能够为顾客提供具有更长保质期的蔬菜。而且......

reflection.en: This Norwegian farm represents a remarkable feat of human ingenuity and dedication to efficiency. The meticulous, hands-off process from sowing to packaging underscores a commitment to excellence in every step. It calls to mind the biblical encouragement to 'whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.'
reflection.zh: 这座挪威的农场是人类智慧和对效率奉献的卓越体现。从播种到包装的细致、无接触过程，彰显了在每一个环节追求卓越的承诺。这让人想起圣经的鼓励：“无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是为主做的，不像为人做的。”

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Museums on prescription: How cultural activities are becoming crucial to the public health debate
title.zh: 处方上的博物馆：文化活动如何成为公共卫生辩论的关键

summary.en: On June 18, 2026, European leaders signed a declaration in Brussels, elevating culture to a strategic priority for the first time. This declaration, 'Europe for Culture—Culture for Europe,' outlines 12 principles, including the significant impact of culture on health, acknowledging its role in public well-being.
summary.zh: 2026年6月18日，欧洲领导人在布鲁塞尔签署了一项宣言，首次将文化提升为战略重点。该宣言“欧洲促进文化——文化促进欧洲”概述了12项原则，其中包括文化对健康的重大影响，并承认其在公众福祉中的作用。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

On June 18, 2026, on the sidelines of the European Council in Brussels, the European Parliament, the European Commission and the Council of the European Union signed a joint declaration making culture a strategic priority for the first time.

This text, " Europe for Culture—Culture for Europe ," sets out 12 key principles intended to inspire, if not guide, member states' cultural policies. Among these principles is culture's impact on health. The Commission explicitly references the conclusions of a report by experts from member states, entitled Culture for Health , which highlights the beneficial effects of culture on health and well-being.

Culture is no longer championed merely as heritage—a source of attachment and a sense of belonging for individuals—or as an economic driver within the creative industries. It is becoming a resource for public health and social cohesion.

This shift is part of a wider trend inspiring pilot initiatives and policy directions at various levels by placing a new priority on neuroscience research into how cultural practices affect the brain and well-being. The European network Culture Next has just published a report, "Culture as Care: Participation, Health and Collective Well-Being in European Cities" , which directly builds on the terms of the declaration.

In the report, culture is described not as a substitute for social, health or educational policies, but as that which fosters care through participation itself—via the meeting places and cultural spaces accommodating mutual recognition and collective action that it makes possible.

The report places particular emphasis on young people, calling for a move beyond an "access" approach (bringing young people to cultural institutions) to recognize the role they already play as creators and organizers, often outside institutional frameworks (in line with a perspective more closely aligned with the principle of the "right to culture").

The European Commission's "Culture and Health—Time to Act" report (2025) calls for the development of a health ecosystem to address a range of socio-health issues that characterize the European continent today and that are contributing to a gradual deterioration in general health conditions, both physical and mental : post-pandemic burnout, an aging population, increasing social isolation, a worrying geopolitical context and growing inequalities.

The concept of a health ecosystem was first put forward in the World Health Organization (WHO) report published in 2019, titled " "What are the real benefits of engaging in the arts for health and well-being? ."...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 2026年6月18日，在布鲁塞尔举行的欧洲理事会会议期间，欧洲议会、欧盟委员会和欧盟理事会签署了一项联合声明，首次将文化作为战略优先事项。 这篇题为“文化的欧洲——欧洲的文化”的文本提出了 12 条关键原则，旨在激励（如果不是指导的话）成员国的文化政策。这些原则之一是文化对健康的影响。委员会明确引用了成员国专家题为《文化促进健康》的报告的结论，该报告强调了文化对健康和福祉的有益影响。 文化不再仅仅被视为遗产（个人依恋和归属感的来源）或创意产业的经济驱动力。它正在成为公共卫生和社会凝聚力的资源。 这一转变是更广泛趋势的一部分，通过将神经科学研究置于文化实践如何影响大脑和福祉的新优先地位，激发各个层面的试点举措和政策方向。欧洲网络“Culture Next”刚刚发表了一份报告，《文化即关怀：欧洲城市的参与、健康和集体福祉》，该报告直接建立在宣言的条款之上。 在报告中，文化不是被描述为社会、健康或教育政策的替代品，而是通过参与本身来促进关怀——通过会议场所和文化空间，容纳相互承认和集体行动。 该报告特别强调年轻人，呼吁超越“准入”方式（将年轻人带入文化机构），认识到他们作为创造者和组织者已经发挥的作用，通常是在机构框架之外（符合与“文化权”原则更加一致的观点）。 欧盟委员会的《文化与健康——采取行动的时刻》报告（2025）呼吁发展健康生态系统，以解决当今欧洲大陆的一系列社会健康问题，这些问题导致身体和精神上的总体健康状况逐渐恶化：大流行后的倦怠、人口老龄化、社会孤立加剧、令人担忧的地缘政治环境和日益严重的不平等。 健康生态系统的概念最早是在世界卫生组织（WHO）2019年发布的报告中首次提出，题为《从事艺术对健康和福祉的真正好处是什么？ ……”

reflection.en: The European Union's formal recognition of culture's role in public health marks a significant shift. It acknowledges that engaging with arts and heritage is not merely a leisure activity but a vital component of healing and well-being, echoing the ancient truth that our hearts can be mended. This declaration offers a hopeful vision for how societies can...
reflection.zh: 欧盟正式承认文化在公共卫生中的作用，标志着一个重要的转变。它认识到，参与艺术和遗产不仅仅是一种休闲活动，而是治愈和福祉的重要组成部分，这与我们心灵可以得到修复的古老真理相呼应。这项宣言为社会如何通过创造性表达和共享文化体验来促进整体健康提供了一个充满希望的愿景。
